title: Condensate food chain: predators persist and cycle with their prey only on a mixed diet; restricting them after a fork to prey droplets alone or to dissolved prey alone kills them on 3/3 seeds each, while intact runs persist on 4/4 seeds (128^2) and 2/2 at 256^2
summary: Variant of c36's closed condensate food chain with chi=0 (no prey-predator repulsion) and k0=0.002 (world.py, defaults; 20261026T1131-c42-foodchain-cycles-sighting). From noise, predator droplets engulf prey droplets as rings, thin out and fragment, and prey droplets renucleate from fuel; predators are alive at t=12000 on seeds 0-3 at 128^2 (13-35 droplets late) and at t=10000 on seeds 0-1 at 256^2 (labkit packs, 50 and 69 predator components at the end). Predator mass lags prey mass by 700-800 t (best cross-correlation r 0.61-0.88 on 5 runs, two grid sizes) with irregular predator peaks spaced 500-2700 t (median ~1800). The matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0, seed 0) is a frozen emulsion of 70-72 prey droplets. Forks at t=3000 that let predators eat only dissolved prey (ca<0.3) or only prey droplets (ca>=0.3) end in predator extinction at t=5500, 8800, 11000 and 6900, 9700, 8800 (seeds 0-2, fork_ablation.png); with dissolved prey only from t=0 no predator droplet ever forms. A literature positive control (spatial Rosenzweig-MacArthur with a per-site extinction floor, control/) shows the same logic the condensates lack without the alternative food: the well-mixed and the synchronised 128^2 versions go extinct at the first trough (t=25), L=16-32 die (t<=490), L=64-128 persist to t=3000 by asynchronous local cycles. Limits: neither species shows labkit persistent splits (0 at K=20 frames; prey mostly appear by nucleation, predators by ring fragmentation), so D is not shown; E holds by construction.

finding.operator: mixed diet: predator condensate eats both prey droplets (contact predation) and the prey's dissolved phase (alternative food)
finding.control: fork at t=3000 restricting predation to dissolved prey only (eatmode 1) or to prey droplets only (eatmode 2), same seeds 0-2, 128^2, t=12000; predator-free twin (pred_on 0); 256^2 grid check; chi/k0/Ksat/Mb/interference screen at 128^2
finding.result: predator last alive t: intact >=12000 on seeds 0,1,2,3 (128^2) and >=10000 on seeds 0,1 (256^2); dissolved-only fork 11000, 5500, 8800; droplet-only fork 6900, 9700, 8800; dissolved-only from t=0: no predator droplet forms (seeds 0,1); droplet-only from t=0: 7900, 7300. Prey->predator lag 700-800 t, r 0.61-0.88. Screen (chi 0.3 unless noted, seed 0, 128^2): base 2000, Ksat 0.1 k2 1 1500, Mb 0.003 1600 (prey eaten out), Bint 0.1 1500, chi 0 2600, chi -0.3 2300, chi 0.3 k0 0.003 2500, chi 0/-0.3 k0 0.003 >=8000 (mostly grazing dissolved prey)
